subject: planner: fix mv index path will be leveraged as index join's probe side (#50439)
summary: Planner now rejects MV-index access paths when building index-join inner IndexScan plans, avoiding duplicate-handle scans that can produce incorrect join multiplicity/results; an integration case asserts `INL_JOIN` becomes inapplicable and falls back to `HashJoin` with a warning. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in this commit relative to its first parent; later upstream/master history does not indicate a follow-up fix for a regression introduced here.
